entries.summary: Added the shared rule that a required choice may select only an actually available option; Penance and Property Dues inherit that rule from current game authority.
Current v0.7.1 card authority explicitly states that Neutral Observers overrides other Gambit-order effects but does not change Tactic order, so Fog may still determine Tactic order.
Current v0.7.1 authority resolves the Redemption and Attrition destination conflict through the Golden Rule that the more specific conflicting effect controls.

PR #1435 fixed the reviewed Gambit/Tactic destination follow-up sequence by preserving terse referents, promoting explicit destination authority, and requiring concrete destination values; #1441 generalized recency-aware conversational retrieval.
PR #1435 fixed the exact reviewed destination follow-up chain, including terse corrections such as 'no, their destinations'; #1441 generalized the conversation-focus behavior.
The opening Gambit/Tactic distinction turn belongs to the exact reviewed destination conversation fixed and regression-covered by PR #1435.
This reviewed follow-up is part of the same exact Gambit/Tactic destination conversation fixed and regression-covered by PR #1435.

Added a deterministic current-v0.7.1 scope precheck for the reviewed strategy, lore/history, costume/visual-design, morality/design, and version-history request families. These requests now return source-free out_of_scope results before corpus retrieval or model-budget reservation, while deck-construction and Leader rules questions continue to the canonical Rules Arbiter.

These reviewed interactions had correct substantive rulings, current authority, sufficient retrieval, and only an overly weak classification. PR #1419 tightened the current v0.7.1 explicit-versus-inferred boundary and added deterministic classification-contract coverage; later behavior revisions retain that boundary.

Force the complete v0.7.1 Surveillance/Interference procedure into Intelligence interaction retrieval and require the Arbiter to preserve prerequisites, separate costs and timings, destinations, replacement/pass choices, revision rights, and no-reopen rules. The exact reviewed Surveillance -> already-face-up commitment -> Interference-cost follow-up chain is regression-covered against Direct Interference and Interference-after-Surveillance authority.
Promote the governing v0.7.1 Normal Capture and Front Line authority for Territory-capture questions and require those passages to appear in the top three retrieval results.

Promote the current v0.7.1 Shock and Awe card and Conflicting victory benefits rule for same-victory restriction questions, including terse follow-ups; include War Crimes authority when the overlap is named.

Promote the current v0.7.1 Treaty Articles and Peace Treaty timing authority for sixth-ratification questions and terse timing follow-ups, with Accepted or Refused Terms authority when that path is named.

Promote the current v0.7.1 Mystics progression and Transmutation procedure for second-Rite ability questions, natural procedure paraphrases, and terse follow-ups; preserve Spirit Walker authority when that Leader is part of the active topic.
Expand tied opening-roll and first-player phrasing to the current v0.7.1 Setup authority so the explicit 'Reroll ties' rule is retrieved rather than forcing an unnecessary provisional ruling.

Expand opening-Hand and setup query phrasing so the current v0.7.1 draw-four, discard-one, keep-three setup procedure appears in the top retrieval results for starting-draw and starting-Hand-size questions without contaminating normal turn draws or Intelligence Mission startup.

Recognize natural questions about when a played card is discarded and promote the current v0.7.1 Action-card destination rule: resolve the Action effect, then put the card in the Discard Pile unless it becomes an Asset or Overlay or its effect gives another destination, without overriding Gambit or Tactic destination authority.

The current v0.7.1 retrieval and prompt path now supplies the Quick Battle Reference, complete Battle Sequence, advantage/disadvantage authority, and Defensive Edge authority for the reviewed post-commitment game-state question. Regression coverage requires whole-sequence reconstruction and preserves the distinction between ordinary advantage on battle dice and Defensive Edge on tied battle totals.

Promote the v0.7.1 Golden Rules authority whenever a player asks which instruction controls a genuine specific-versus-general conflict, while retaining the normal battle sequence alongside it for battle-order questions.

Current v0.7.1 retrieval directly supplies Onward's During Movement permission together with the shared rule that movement which begins a battle ends that movement sequence and loses unused movement. The reviewed continuation and post-battle questions are now regression-covered without a new runtime behavior change.

Add a general ordered-reference rule for multi-object card text so pronouns such as 'that card' and 'it' remain bound to the most recent compatible object introduced by the instruction after already-resolved card movement. Good Faith therefore cannot silently switch those later references back to the source Asset after that Asset has been discarded.

The production session chronology shows 'What benefit does this give me?' immediately followed the Good Faith exchange despite a stale audit rationale describing a different prior topic. Current contextual retrieval preserves that real Good Faith referent and returns Good Faith as the first authority source; regression coverage now locks the exact continuity behavior.

Map the legacy phrase 'defender advantage' and close variants to the current v0.7.1 Defensive Edge authority. This prevents generic dice Advantage from outranking the controlling tie-break rule while leaving ordinary Advantage and double-Advantage questions unchanged.
